summary: Frontend-only testing of Application Detail pages (/applications/:slug). All 10 industry pages render correctly with unique UAE-focused content including hero, quick specs, industry challenges, recommended solutions, FAQs, and CTAs. Navigation from ApplicationsIndex to detail pages works. Links to products/technology and contact pages functional.

features_tested.details: Page loads with correct hero image, title 'Shopfront Signage', tagline, UAE-focused description. Quick specs show Brightness (3,000-10,000 NITS), Pixel Pitch (P2.5-P10), IP65 Rating, Viewing Distance (1-30 meters).

Page loads with 'Hospitality & Hotels' title, different specs (400-1,500 NITS, P0.9-P2.5, 10,000:1+ Contrast, 200-400 W/SQM). Industry-specific challenges like 'Aesthetic Integration' and 'Ambient Lighting Varies'.
Page loads with 'Corporate & Offices' title, specs (400-800 NITS, P0.7-P1.9, 4K-8K+ Resolution, 100,000 HRS MTBF). Challenges include 'Meeting Room Versatility' and 'Corporate AV Integration'.
Page loads with 'Outdoor & Billboards' title, high-brightness specs (7,000-12,000 NITS, P4-P20, IP65/IP68, Operating Temp -20 to 60°C). UAE-specific challenges like 'Extreme Heat' and 'Sand & Dust'.
Loads with correct title 'Retail & Shopping Malls', specs for mall environments (800-2,000 NITS, P1.5-P4, 3,840 HZ+ Refresh Rate, 160°+ Viewing Angle).
Loads with 'Healthcare' title, lower brightness specs (300-600 NITS), flicker-free specs (PWM 3,840 HZ+), IP30+ sealed surface. Challenges include 'Infection Control' and 'Patient Comfort'.
Loads with 'Transportation & Airports' title, mission-critical specs (99.99%+ Uptime, Hot-Swap Redundancy, ARINC/SITA Integration). Challenges include '24/7 Reliability'.
Loads with 'Entertainment & Cinemas' title, cinema-grade specs (100,000:1+ Contrast, DCI-P3 Color Gamut, Dolby Vision HDR). Challenges include 'HDR & Color Accuracy'.
Loads with 'Sports & Events' title, stadium specs (5,000-10,000 NITS, 7,680 HZ+ Refresh Rate, IP65/IP68, P4-P16). Challenges include 'Outdoor Durability' and 'High Refresh Rate'.
Loads with 'Education' title, classroom-appropriate specs (400-800 NITS, IR 20-Point Touch, 50,000+ HRS Lifespan). Challenges include 'Budget Constraints' and 'Ease of Use'.
Each industry page displays 4 industry-appropriate specs with icons. Values differ based on industry requirements.
Each page displays 4 industry-specific challenges with descriptions in glassmorphism cards.
Each page shows 2-3 recommended solutions with links to product/technology pages. Links work correctly (e.g., Transparent LED links to /products/transparent-led).
Section fetches from /api/case-studies API and filters by industry tags. Dubai Mall case study shows on shopfront-signage page.
Each page displays 3 industry-specific FAQs with questions and detailed answers.
'All Applications' link at top navigates back to /applications index page.
Cyan button links correctly to /contact page.
Secondary button links to related solution page based on relatedSolution field (e.g., /solutions/retail for shopfront).
Clicking application cards on /applications navigates correctly to /applications/:slug detail pages.
Invalid slugs show 'Application Not Found' message with 'Back to Applications' link.
